Western Carolina is 5-5 and has won two straight, most recently a 26-10 result over Wofford in which the defense recorded 10 tackles for loss. Samford is 4-6 and has won three straight, including a 37-35 finish at No. 19 ETSU that ended on a 7-yard touchdown pass from Gabarri Johnson to Domonique Thomas on the final play. ************************************** (Copy & Paste This Website on you browser to watch LIVE NOW. Thankyou) This link👉 https://watchlivehere.com/ncaaf/ This link👉 https://watchlivehere.com/ncaaf/ ************************************** The quarterbacks give the game its shape. Lex Thomas has thrown for 2391 yards and 10 touchdowns with only 2 interceptions for Western Carolina, and he has Jai Boyd (466 receiving yards, 5 touchdowns) and AJ Colombo (537 receiving yards) to throw to. Johnson has 1752 passing yards and 9 touchdowns for Samford, with Marquise Henderson (490 receiving yards, 3 touchdowns) and Preston Bird (37 catches for 385 yards) among his targets. Both teams have also been winning close games on the defensive end, which suggests this one could be decided by a late stop or a single turnover. Samford sits fifth at 4-3 in the SoCon, and Western Carolina is sixth at 3-3, so the result moves one team ahead of the other in the middle of the pack. For Western Carolina, a win would also push its overall record past .500 for the first time in this stretch. Western Carolina has beaten Wofford six straight times, and Samford needed a last-second field goal to beat the Terriers 10-9. Samford also won 13-6 at Furman earlier in the fall, so its recent success has come in low-scoring games. 4.5 Sacks Interceptions: Jayden Cornelius, 3 Interceptions What to Watch For The quarterback comparison is clear. Lex Thomas has protected the ball well, with 2 interceptions on 2391 passing yards. Gabarri Johnson has thrown 7 interceptions, so Western Carolina’s Jayden Cornelius, who has 3 interceptions, and Samford’s LaShon Young, who has 2, are worth watching on the back end. Pressure may matter just as much. Trystan Anderson has 4.5 sacks for the Catamounts, and Samford’s Spencer Conn has 3.0. Western Carolina’s pass rush was central to the Wofford result, and Samford’s offense will need to give Johnson time to find Henderson, Bird and Cayden Aukerman, who has 35 receptions. On the ground, Josh Perry has 534 rushing yards and 7 touchdowns for Western Carolina.
